name: yxj-paper-os
description: Evidence-bound paper revision authority for assessment, direct writeback, impact closure, and verification.

interface.shortDescription: Paper revision from intent through verification.
interface.longDescription: YXJ Paper OS is a returning paper revision authority. It distinguishes assessment from edit authorization, re-enters from current evidence, applies requested manuscript changes directly, propagates scientific and experimental deltas across every affected paper surface, and verifies the resulting artifacts without workflow bureaucracy.
capabilities: Explicit assess, design, revise, and audit intent
Scientific-evidence, reference, and exemplar authority boundaries
Direct writeback with cross-surface impact closure
interface.defaultPrompt: Use YXJ Paper OS as the paper revision authority: infer whether the request is assess, design, revise, or audit; inspect current evidence and artifacts; apply explicit revisions directly; propagate material changes across all affected paper surfaces; preserve scientific boundaries; and verify the resulting artifacts.
